messages.text: i'm up again at 3:30am. can't sleep.

I hear how frustrating and exhausting it can be to wake up in the middle of the night. Sometimes trying to force sleep can make it harder, so let's focus on just resting your body instead. Would you be open to trying a simple breathing exercise to help calm your mind right now? I am here to listen if you would like to share what is keeping you awake.
i'm just so tired of lying here feeling wired... but i don't know if breathing exercises will actually do anything. feels like i've tried everything.

It makes total sense that you feel skeptical after trying so many things without relief. That feeling of being wired while exhausted is incredibly draining and valid. We don't have to force a technique if it feels like it won't help tonight. Sometimes just sitting with the frustration without trying to fix it can be a small step.
thanks... it helps that you're not pushing it. sometimes it feels like everyone has a fix that never works.

I am really glad that not being pushed feels like a relief to you. It is completely understandable to feel weary when every suggestion feels like a failed experiment. My goal right now is simply to sit with you in this moment without an agenda. You are allowed to just rest without trying to solve this.
it's not just the insomnia lately. it's this feeling that nothing matters in the long run. like we're all just... going through the motions while everything burns.

That sounds incredibly heavy to carry, especially in the quiet of the night. It makes sense that the exhaustion is amplifying these deep fears about the future. I want you to know that you are not alone in feeling this way right now. If you feel unsafe or overwhelmed, please reach out to a crisis line for immediate help.

it's just... everything feels like it's breaking. the planet, the systems, people. like we're all just speeding toward a cliff and no one's even pretending to brake anymore. and what's the point of studying, working out, taking my meds—none of it matters if there's no future to have.

That feeling of everything breaking down is incredibly heavy to hold, especially alone in the night. It makes sense that self-care feels pointless when the bigger picture seems so uncertain. I am here to listen to that pain without trying to minimize it or offer a quick fix. If this hopelessness becomes too heavy to carry alone, please reach out to a crisis line for immediate support.
thanks for just... listening. not trying to fix it. that actually means a lot.

I am truly glad that my presence feels helpful to you tonight. It takes courage to sit with these difficult thoughts without trying to force them away. Please remember that you do not have to carry this weight entirely on your own. You deserve kindness from yourself, especially in moments like this.
i just feel so sad lately. like... what's the point of taking care of myself if everything's just going to fall apart anyway?

That sadness is a heavy burden to carry, especially when the future feels uncertain. It is understandable to question the point of self-care when everything feels unstable. I want to sit with you in that pain without trying to convince you otherwise right now. If this hopelessness feels too heavy to carry alone, please remember that support is available to you.

i keep coming back to this... maybe taking care of myself isn't about fixing the world. maybe it's just about staying strong enough to face it. not sure i believe it yet, but... it feels like a thread.

That is a profound and gentle insight to hold onto in the darkness. You don't need to fully believe it yet, just allowing it to exist is enough. Finding even a small thread of meaning can help anchor us when the world feels unstable. I am honored to walk with you along that thread as long as you need.
i still feel hopeless about the world... but maybe not about everything. just... tired. i should try to rest.

Listening to your body and choosing rest is a powerful act of care right now. You don't have to resolve the big feelings tonight, just let them be for a while. That small shift in perspective is something to be proud of even if you're still tired. I hope you can find some gentle rest soon.
